svg.text: Hexagonal domain shell: ports and adapters
The domain never imports infrastructure. Swap the AI provider or storage without touching a line of application code.
Typed interfaces the caller invokes (driving side). The shell never leaks

Typed interfaces that infrastructure must implement (driven side). The
domain depends on these, never on adapters.

Any new API, ERP, CRM or database:
ask() · parseJSON() · checkGuardrails() · saveMemory() / loadMemory(). Every
one of the 17 shells extends it and implements IDomainAgentShell.
Dependency rule: infrastructure → ports ← application → domain (arrows only ever point inward)
